Commentary.Commentary: Right then. A washout in the first game. An Indian domination in the second. It was all about the visitors in the third as they managed to pull off an excellent win to level the 3-match T20I series. The two sides now will face off in the longer format of the game. The first one of the three Tests begins on October 2, 2019 at 0930 local (0400 GMT) in Visakhapatnam. Do join us for all the action. Take care and goodbye!

South African skipper, QUINTON DE KOCK IS ALSO THE MAN OF THE SERIES! He starts by saying that they kept things simple. Adds that there was something on offer for the quick bowlers and praises his spinners for keeping things tight. Lauds Hendricks for mixing up his pace and reading the conditions well. States that their fielding was really good too and they were very focused.

Time for the Indian skipper now. On his decision of batting first, Kohli starts by saying that's going to be the template heading into the T20 World Cup. Adds that the team is willing to do the hard work and that is a good thing. Praises the South African bowlers for hitting the right areas and admits that India didn't read the tempo of the game well. Feels that chasing has always been easier but only in T20 cricket as just a small partnership can help you win the game. He says that defending even 200 will be tougher if there are just a couple of good stands. On team selections, Kohli replies that they want to get the right squad as quickly as they can and further adds that those playing have been doing well in domestic cricket. Adds that they will continue backing the youngsters. Talks about the batting depth, an area they are looking to strengthen.

Man of the Match goes to Beuran Hendricks for his excellent bowling performance. Hendricks says that things worked really well for him. Mentions that he has been working hard behind the scenes. Adds that he doesn't look at the pitch much but he did get some assistance from the surface. He finishes by saying that one needs to be consistent with his lines and lengths to become a successful T20 bowler.

Temba Bavuma says he made his debut in T20Is when he did not expect it but he has worked hard and it has started off well. States you need to have the mindset to score quickly. Further adds he does not have the power like Gayle but his job is to keep the scoreboard ticking. On the six he hit in Mohali, he replies that he surprised himself and realized he can hit the ball a long way. Ends by saying they will get a lot of confidence after this win and it is important as there is a Test series coming up which is not going to be easy.

The Indian bowlers can't be blamed a lot as they did not have a lot to defend. They still could have been a lot better with their lines and lengths. In the end, you have to say, the Indians were outplayed in every department tonight. Stay tuned for the presentation in a while. Before that, Bavuma is giving an interview.

In the run chase, the South African openers, Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks did an excellent job by adding 76 runs. They were helped by the Indian bowlers who were extremely poor. Every bowler, even the spinners were extremely short which made it easy for the batters to score the runs. Reeza Hendricks did fall after getting a start but de Kock continued and Bavuma also fulfilled his role. The two added another important stand and took their side over the line. De Kock looked absolutely fluent throughout the innings and apart from that missed review chance by the Indians, he did not offer any opening.

A comprehensive win for the South Africans. An excellent performance in a must-win game from them. Also, this is de Kock's first win as T20I skipper and he has played an integral part in it. However, a lot of credit has to be given to their bowlers as they set up the game for them. Brilliant efforts from Beuran Hendricks, who was brought into the team for this game, the two spinners and Rabada ensured they keep India to a total which was under par.

SIX! Well, If you don't allow the single to win the game, Bavuma will seal it with a six. Shortish ball on middle, Bavuma stays back and hammers this over the long on fence for a maximum. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 9 WICKETS AND DRAW THE SERIES 1-1.

Quicker one on the pads, Bavuma works it towards square leg and looks for a run. Jadeja there hares at the ball and makes sure the batters do not get the winning run with ball in his stride. Excellent work, even after knowing the result. 100 percent commitment.
Flighted ball on off, Bavuma sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Flatter one on middle, blocked nicely.
Shortish one, de Kock goes to pull but gets it off the higher part of the bat towards long on for a run.
Quicker one around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single by QdK.
On middle, Bavuma sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Fuller one on the leg stump, nudged towards fine leg for a single.
Shortish length, punched through covers for a run.
Fires this one around off and makes it turn away from the batter. Bavuma is beaten all ends up.
Goes for the reverse sweep but finds the point fielder. This was a quicker one on middle.
Bavuma now retains strike as he guides it through point.
50-run stand up! Another good one and this stand has ensured South Africa's win. De Kock works this through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

SIX! That made a cracking sound off the bat. 5th maximum for de Kock. This is a risk free shot. With the turn, the slog sweep, it is right off the middle and into the mid-wicket stand. 10 more needed.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
FOUR! De Kock scoring boundaries at will now. This is floated up outside off. De Kock goes down on one knee and lofts it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Krunal Pandya is back!
Fuller around off, Bavuma goes for a reverse sweep but can't connect
Beaten this time. A fullish length ball, closer to the off pole. Bavuma plays down the line of the ball but misses.
In the air... Just short of the cover fielder. Maybe the ball stopped a bit in the air as Bavuma's drive goes uppishly towards cover.
On the pads this time, QdK looks to flick but can't connect it well. It lands short of the fine leg fielder. They taken on.
On middle again, Bavuma goes back and sweeps it through square for an easy single.
Flighted ball around middle, Bavuma paddle sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple.
Finally, Ravindra Jadeja is brought into the attack!
A single to end as this is worked through mid-wicket.
One more short ball on off, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.
Angles this one on off from around the wicket. It is kept out.
FOUR! De Kock wants to end this early now. A boundary after the biggie. This is full and outside off. De Kock lofts it over covers and bags a boundary. Also, de Kock now has 1000 runs in T20Is.
SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one. Once again this is bowled right in de Kock's zone. Short and on middle, de Kock pulls it with utmost ease over the square leg fence.
Way too short and outside off. It is left alone. Wided.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped to covers.
Good length ball around off, blocked towards point. Another 10 run over for the visitors.

FOUR! Poor ball and got the treatment it deserved. This is full toss on the pads, Bavuma this time flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence. Rohit seemed unhappy there as he pointed something to the bowler.
FOUR! Up and over! Good length ball around off, Bavuma shuffles towards the leg side and lifts it over the cover fieldsman for a boundary.
On the pads this time, flicked for a couple through square leg.

Excellent stop from Rohit Sharma! Superb anticipation reflex. Good length ball outside off, Bavuma looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball looked to be racing towards the third man fence but Rohit Sharma at first slip dives to his right and stops.
Fuller one to start with. It is on off, Bavuma drives it straight back to the bowler.
Navdeep Saini is back on!
A dot to end an action-packed over. 10 runs and a wicket from it. Short and outside off, de Kock looks to upper cut it but misses.

FOUR! Fifty for de Kock, h gets there in style. Consecutive fifties for him and it is his 4th in T20Is. He is really relishing the role of becoming a skipper with the bat. He though would want to continue and probably hit the winning runs which levels the series. He goes inside out to get to the milestone. It is full and outside off. De Kock lofts it over covers and it races away to the fence.
WIDE! Another slower one outside off, this one grips off the surface and turns away too. It goes outside the tramline and it is wided.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

FOUR! Too easy for de Kock. Shorter and on the body, de Kock swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. The Indian bowlers have bowled too short to him today and that has played in his hands.

On the fuller side around off, Bavuma looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge. The batters feel it is a boundary and hence do not run. The third man fielder makes a brilliant stop as he covers a lot of ground to his left, dives and stops it. A single is taken in the end.
Temba Bavuma is the next man in for the visitors. A calm innings is the need of the hour for South Africa.

OUT! That is a stunning catch from Kohli. We saw him take one brilliant catch in the second T20I to dismiss de Kock, this time it is one to dismiss his opening partner. A wicket at last for the Indians but maybe it is a little too late. The bowling change has worked wonders for the Indian side. Pandya makes an impact straightaway. This is short and on middle, it sticks in the surface. Hendricks is early in the shot. He ends up mistiming the shot. It lobs towards mid on where the fielder runs to his right, dives forward and takes it inches above the ground. Finally the crowd has something to cheer about. Also, let me remind you, it was Kohli's brilliant catch in the last game which shifted momentum, are we in for something similar here?
Hardik into the attack now! India needs wickets in clusters from him. Can he do that?
One more single to end! On middle, it is worked towards short fine leg for one. 59 more needed in 10 overs.
Looks to go big as he brings out the slog sweep. Due to the slowness of the wicket, he is a touch early in the shot. It goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, it is worked around the corner for one.
Loopy ball outside off, de Kock looks to go over covers but the ball turns back in, it goes off the inner half down to long off for one.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Slightly short and turning back into the batter. De Kock chips it in the mid-wicket region for one.
A quicker one, turning into the batter, pushed towards backward square leg for a single. Another 10 run over and the run chase for the visitors well on course.
A quicker one on the stumps this time, Reeza gets his bat down in time and works it towards the square leg region for a run.
Beaten this time. A quicker one this time around off. Hendricks looks to drive but is beaten.
Slower through the air, worked towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! Hammered! Slightly short, and QdK doesn't miss out on that one. He goes back and hammers it over the long on fence. His third six.
Flatter on the off stump, Hendricks pushes it through point for a run.

Good fielding! The extra ball almost cost a boundary there. De Kock plays the reverse sweep and he hits it through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two. An expensive start for Pandya. 75 needed in 72 balls. South Africa's game to lose now.
WIDE! Down the leg side and it has been wided.
On middle, this is pushed past the bowler and down to long on for one.
De Kock makes room again and guides it past point only for one though.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! That is a fine shot! Shorter and turning away from off. Reeza goes back and pushes it through covers. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, slides and pushes it back in. The long off fielder does the mopping up job. Two taken. The umpire though takes it upstairs as he wants to have a look. Replays show that is tough and go. In the end, he signals a boundary.
Straightaway sweeps the ball turning into him. Hits it nicely through mid-wicket for one.
Krunal Pandya replaces Chahar.
De Kock makes room, Sunder follows him. He chops it towards point for one.

A huge shout but not given! Sundar is slightly disappointed as he walks back to his bowling stride. He felt that was out but no reviews left. This is flatter and around middle. De Kock looks to sweep but misses. He gets hit on the pads. An appeal but it is turned down. Looked pretty close. Yes, the replays roll in and shows three reds. It was going to hit the leg stump. The review lost might cost the Indians dearly.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Drags his sweep from outside off now and hits it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Runs coming easily now. Short and on middle, Hendricks goes back and pulls it through square leg. It is in the gap and it races away.
Flatter and slightly fuller outside off, Reeza misreads the length. He looks to cut but gets beaten.
Sundar into the attack for his 3rd over.
Back of a length ball around middle, Hendricks pulls it through mid-wicket for a run. 43 runs without a wicket, an excellent Powerplay for the visitors.
Good length ball this, QdK pushes towards cover for a single this time.
Shortish one this time, de Kock cuts but finds the gully fielder.

NOT OUT! Yes, going down the leg side. What a waste of the review. Chahar gets this slower one right this time. Hendricks looks to work it down the leg side but is hit on the pads. That looks to be going down the leg side but hello, the skipper however has words with his bowler and then opts for the DRS. Here comes the Ball Tracker and confirms it is going way down the leg side. Kohli has his cap on his face. The ball goes towards square leg and a leg bye has been taken.
Review time! An appeal for an LBW has been turned down. India review. Looks to be sliding down leg.
WIDE! Goes for the slower one but misses his line. The ball goes down the leg side and has been wided.
FOUR! Poor ball and hammered into the mid-wicket fence. Chahar bowls it short around off, Hendricks stays on the back foot and drills it to the mid-wicket fence.
Good length ball outside off, de Kock cuts it through cover-point for a single.

Dropped? Not sure! Saini though gets away with one here. He bowls it short and way outside off. De Kock slaps it uppishly towards cover. Not sure if it carried or no. Iyer dives to his right, stretches one hand out and stops it. Saves three for his side in the end. Replays does not give a clear picture but it seemed like it did not carry.
Good batting! Reeza need not do anything silly so he guides it towards backward point and gets to the other end.
Goes short again, de Kock pulls it through square leg, this time along the ground only for one.

SIX! Not learning is Saini here. This is not the length you bowl to de Kock. It is slightly short and outside off. De Kock feeds on such lengths. He rocks back and pulls it over the square leg fence again. This over probably releases all the pressure that was built.

Good work by Pant again! India really need to save as many runs as possible in the field. Shorter and closer to the body. De Kock looks to cut by making room but ends up chopping it to the right of the keeper who dives and stops it.

SIX! Welcome into the attack, Saini. Slightly shorter and on middle, de Kock stands tall and pulls it nonchalantly over the square leg for a biggie. Pressure on the bowler now, he has gone for a maximum on the first ball.
Navdeep Saini into the attack.
FOUR! Slapped! A welcome boundary this! Slightly short and outside off, a lot of width on offer. Reeza Hendricks pounces on it and smashes it through covers.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one. 5000 T20 runs for de Kock.

Cut him into half! Excellent work by Pant. This is a back of a length ball on off, it jags back in sharply. De Kock's inside edge is beaten as he tries to play it on the leg side. Pant dives to his right and with one hand stops it, not cleanly but does not concede a run.
De Kock makes room and Chahar bowls it wide outside off. De Kock ends up mistiming it towards cover. He wants a run but is sent back.
Shorter but close to the off pole. De Kock cuts it but straight to point.
Another single! Back of a length on off, RH pushes it towards extra cover and gets to the other end.
Fires it on the pads, de Kock looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shortish and closer to the off pole, this is cut to point.
FOUR! That is creamed! Beautiful from de Kock. This is a little too full outside off. De Kock strokes it through covers. Jadeja at long off runs to his right, dives but his effort goes in vain.

A leg bye! Flatter and on middle, it turns back in. Reeza looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the off side and the batters go for one. The fielder picks the ball and throws it powerfully towards the non-striker's end. The ball lands before the stumps but bounces over it. The fielder backing up does well to not charge in, stay calm and stop it. Could've been four overthrows.
Very full, almost a yorker. Reeza jams it towards mid-wicket where the fielder slides and stops a run.
Flatter and on off, de Kock guides it towards point for a quick run.
Good length ball again, Hendricks finds the cover fielder to his back foot punch. Excellent over from Chahar.
Blocks it well this time. Good length ball around off again, Hendricks blocks off the back foot.
Another beauty from Chahar but it can't get the edge. Length ball, closer to the off pole this time. Hendricks again pokes at but he is beaten by the away movement. Excellent bowling from Chahar.
Beaten! Good length ball around off, it shapes away from Hendricks who has a poke but misses. Chahar roars out an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Shortish ball around off, de Kock works it towards third man for a run.

Good length ball, closer to the off pole, QdK looks to work it towards third man but gets an outside edge towards skipper Kohli. Who takes it on the bounce and fires a direct hit. The ball hits the timber but QdK was in. The ball goes towards the off side, de Kock thinks of a run again but Kohli is quick at the ball again.
Deepak Chahar to bowl from the other end.
Excellent stop from Rohit! A fuller delivery outside off, QdK drills it towards cover but the shot has been intercepted by diving Rohit Sharma. Just a single.
Quicker one this time, worked towards the leg side by de Kock.
On the pads this time, QdK tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Slightly short, pushed towards cover for nothing.

FOUR! Driven nicely and the ball races to the fence. Quick outfield. A fuller floated ball, de Kock leans into the shot and drives it through the covers into the fence. Off the mark in style is the Protea skipper.
Good length ball angling into the batter, Reeza works it towards square leg to get off the mark.

Welcome back for the run chase. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks are out in the middle. The Indian players have taken their positions. Washington Sundar will start the proceedings for the hosts. We are all in readiness for the run chase.
